facts.fact: Policy expert Alimure Ali Awuda says South Sudan's current land registration system is manual and urges introducing a digital registration process.
Central Equatoria's Minister of Information says engineers are developing a unified digital land registration system integrating applications, registration and transfers, beginning with Juba County.
facts.system: digital land registration and management system

systems.system: digital land registration and management system

facts.fact: Undersecretary Louis Kwot says the Ministry of Lands, which took custody of the Land Registry from the judiciary, is in the process of implementing a digitalised land registry.

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development

facts.fact: IOM says the EU-funded Catalysing Durable Solutions programme, begun 1 January 2026 in Rubkona and Yei River counties, will advance the digitalization of land records.

note: States only a plan: the commissioner directed engineers to design a single land system; nothing built or in service.
Article concerns paper voter registration; none of this register stated.
Only a planned aerial survey and addressing system for Juba; no register of this kind stated.

facts.fact: FAO issued a request for proposal on 23 September 2025 for consultancy services to develop a Land Information System for South Sudan.
facts.system: Land Information System (LIS) for South Sudan

note: The ministry only announced plans to digitalise the land registry; no system under way or in service.

facts.fact: Eye Radio quotes the head of the South Sudan Land Commission saying the lands ministry is establishing a land registrar within the ministry to digitalise the land registry system and take over the role from the judiciary.

note: A digital land registration system is only a civil society recommendation; no register or digitisation stated.
Aerial mapping of Juba is a mapping project to ease a digital land registry, with no register stated as built.

facts.fact: Radio Tamazuj reports that in Western Bahr el Ghazal State the lands ministry keeps two paper land register books and still issues plot documents the traditional way, with no digitised titling system, and its lands director asked partners for computers and training to digitise.
facts.system: land register books, Western Bahr el Ghazal
